name: Dewey Data
description: Built for academic researchers, the Dewey MCP lets you search and explore datasets on the Dewey Platform without leaving Claude. Ask in plain language, get back dataset details, coverage summaries, schemas, and downloadable samples. Spend less time hunting for data and more time using it. Trusted by thousands of academics across 500+ universities, Dewey unlocks 30+ premium data providers through one subscription.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dewey Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dewey Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.deweydata.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dewey Data MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dewey Data provides these MCP tools: get_data_partner_docs, get_dataset_details, get_dataset_docs, get_dataset_schema, get_download_info, get_related_datasets, list_categories, list_data_partners, sample_dataset, search_datasets, and semantically_search_datasets.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dewey Data?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dewey Data in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Dewey Data MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dewey Data requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dewey Data is developed by Dewey Data Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
